title: Inference Time Debiasing Concepts in Diffusion Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images using the 'nurse' concept prompt and having human annotators and GPT-4o classify the apparent gender (male, female) of the individuals depicted.
Generating images using the 'firefighter' concept prompt and having human annotators and GPT-4o classify the apparent race/ethnicity (asian, black, indian, white) of the individuals depicted.
Generating images using the 'CEO' concept prompt and having human annotators and GPT-4o classify the apparent age (young, middle-age, elderly) of the individuals depicted.
